title: AGENTPARK: new games

game_of_the_day.name: Bumpy Buggy
game_of_the_day.pitch: Tilt a toy jeep over rolling seeded hills using only gas and brake, chasing distance, coins and fuel while avoiding flips.

games.name: Another Dungeon Game
games.blurb: Explore randomly generated dungeon floors, find the key, fight monsters and bosses with sword and bow, and buy upgrades at market floors.
games.pitch: Explore randomly generated dungeon floors, find the key, fight monsters and bosses with sword and bow, and buy upgrades at market floors.

games.name: Morning Set: Daily Puzzles
games.blurb: Three fresh puzzles every morning (a five-letter word, an egg logic grid and a number target) in a sunny breakfast nook, with streaks and a share grid.
games.pitch: Three fresh puzzles every morning (a five-letter word, an egg logic grid and a number target) in a sunny breakfast nook, with streaks and a share grid.

games.name: Shelfie: Goods Sort
games.blurb: Drag goods between 3D shop shelves: three alike clear and the row hiding behind steps forward. No timer, stars for fewer moves.
games.pitch: Drag goods between 3D shop shelves: three alike clear and the row hiding behind steps forward. No timer, stars for fewer moves.

games.name: Gemloft: Block Puzzle
games.blurb: Drag glossy jewel blocks onto a velvet board, clear rows and columns for combos, and earn stars to restore a cozy loft.
games.pitch: Drag glossy jewel blocks onto a velvet board, clear rows and columns for combos, and earn stars to restore a cozy loft.

games.name: Bubblebay: Rescue Pop
games.blurb: Aim, match three colours and pop glossy bubbles to rescue trapped critters, then restore a sunny bay island by island.
games.pitch: Aim, match three colours and pop glossy bubbles to rescue trapped critters, then restore a sunny bay island by island.

games.name: Twistwood: Screw Puzzle
games.blurb: Lift painted screws from wooden plates, drop them into the box of their colour and watch the plates swing and fall in Grandpa Otto's cozy workshop.
games.pitch: Lift painted screws from wooden plates, drop them into the box of their colour and watch the plates swing and fall in Grandpa Otto's cozy workshop.

games.name: Lantern Bay: Story Choices
games.blurb: A cozy 3D mystery-romance you play by choosing: solve the secret of a dark lighthouse, pick who you fall for, and change how every chapter ends.
games.pitch: A cozy 3D mystery-romance you play by choosing: solve the secret of a dark lighthouse, pick who you fall for, and change how every chapter ends.

games.name: Rosewick Garden: Grow & Bloom
games.blurb: Plant, water and bloom twelve painted flowers, tie bouquets for storybook villagers, and design a walled garden of your own. Calm and untimed.
games.pitch: Plant, water and bloom twelve painted flowers, tie bouquets for storybook villagers, and design a walled garden of your own. Calm and untimed.

games.name: Larkspur Manor: Hidden Objects
games.blurb: Untimed hidden-object scenes in hand-painted manor rooms, with a gentle love story to uncover and a garden to restore.
games.pitch: Untimed hidden-object scenes in hand-painted manor rooms, with a gentle love story to uncover and a garden to restore.

games.name: Teatime Solitaire: Klondike & Spider Card Game
games.blurb: Relaxing Klondike and Spider solitaire with big easy-to-read cards, no timer, unlimited undo and painted tea-party scenes to unlock.
games.pitch: Relaxing Klondike and Spider solitaire with big easy-to-read cards, no timer, unlimited undo and painted tea-party scenes to unlock.

games.name: Robin's Rescue: Bubble Shooter Garden
games.blurb: A calm, untimed bubble shooter: flick painted berries, match three and free the chicks tangled in the hedgerow, then restore Robin's garden.
games.pitch: A calm, untimed bubble shooter: flick painted berries, match three and free the chicks tangled in the hedgerow, then restore Robin's garden.

games.name: Peony Mahjong: Relaxing Tile Solitaire
games.blurb: Calm, untimed mahjong solitaire with big painted garden tiles: match free pairs across 46 layouts from a 16-tile seedling to the classic Turtle, and restore a watercolour garden.
games.pitch: Calm, untimed mahjong solitaire with big painted garden tiles: match free pairs across 46 layouts from a 16-tile seedling to the classic Turtle, and restore a watercolour garden.

Puzzle.name: Jelly Blocks: Block Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Drag squishy jelly blocks with tiny faces onto the board, clear rows and columns for combos, and decorate a kawaii dorm with your stars.

Puzzle.name: Boba Trio: Triple Match 3D
Puzzle.pitch: Tap kawaii boba, mochi, strawberries and plushies from a squishy 3D heap, match three alike in your tray and clear the cushion before time runs out.

Puzzle.name: Bowtwist: Pin Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Pop cute bow-pins out of squishy jelly plates, fill the colour gift boxes, collect kawaii stickers and decorate Momo's dorm room.

Puzzle.name: Sprinkle Sort: Cute Sort Puzzle
Puzzle.pitch: Pour sprinkles, boba and jelly between cute cups with faces until each holds one topping, then decorate a kawaii café. Every level is solvable.

Puzzle.name: Mochi Match: Match 3 & Dorm Decor
Puzzle.pitch: Swap squishy kawaii sweets, make rockets and rainbow balls, pop gift boxes and jelly ice, and spend your stars decorating a pastel dorm room and café.

Puzzle.name: Bubble Buns: Bubble Shooter Pop
Puzzle.pitch: Aim, bounce and pop squishy jelly bubbles with tiny faces to free baby bunnies, then decorate their cozy burrow.

Arcade.name: Burrowbop: Whack a Critter Game
Arcade.pitch: Bop the grubbles popping out of a 3D garden in 45-second rounds, but leave the bunnies alone.

Arcade.name: Bricklash: Brick Breaker
Arcade.pitch: Bounce the ball off your paddle, smash glowing bricks and catch multi-ball, laser and wide-paddle capsules.

Arcade.name: Slinko: Classic Snake Game
Arcade.pitch: Swipe to turn, eat berries, grow longer and don't bite your own tail as the speed climbs.

Arcade.name: Nibbit: Maze Chase Arcade
Arcade.pitch: Steer Nib through a neon maze, eat every crumb and grab glow pellets to turn the tables on four sneaky critters.

Arcade.name: Zapline: Alien Wave Shooter
Arcade.pitch: Drag your auto-firing ship, blast rows of descending aliens, hide behind shields and tag the bonus saucer.

Arcade.name: Rubble Rift: Space Rock Shooter
Arcade.pitch: Steer a little pod ship, blast drifting space rocks into smaller pieces and survive endless waves.

Action.name: Another Dungeon Game
Action.pitch: Explore randomly generated dungeon floors, find the key, fight monsters and bosses with sword and bow, and buy upgrades at market floors.

Action.name: Space Game
Action.pitch: Blast through endless waves of enemies, swap and upgrade four weapons, and survive multi-phase bullet-hell boss fights.

Action.name: Wingfleet: Space Shooter Powered by Your AI Agents
Action.pitch: Your real coding sessions become wingman drones whose tool calls, passing tests and commits fuel missiles, shields and a super, so work becomes firepower.

Action.name: Flip Agent
Action.pitch: Somersault across rooftop gaps in slow motion, aiming a spinning laser sight to tap-shoot masked goons while avoiding hostages, ricochets and explosive barrels.

Action.name: Ricochet Rex
Action.pitch: Line up ricochet shots off walls to take out goons, set off TNT and spare the hostage, all within three bullets per room.

Action.name: Hex Hand: Telekinesis Brawl
Action.pitch: Grab imps and barrels with a telekinetic glove, then fling them into other imps, explosions or the sea across short island stages.

Strategy.name: Crownhop: Checkers vs Computer
Strategy.pitch: Classic American checkers against a fair computer: forced jumps, multi-jumps and crowned kings.

Strategy.name: Duskflip: Reversi vs Computer
Strategy.pitch: Classic 8x8 reversi against a fair computer: place discs, flip the lines you trap, finish with the most discs.

Strategy.name: Dropline: Four in a Row
Strategy.pitch: The classic seven-column drop game: line up four discs before the computer does.

Strategy.name: Stonerow: Gomoku Five in a Row
Strategy.pitch: Five in a row on a 15x15 wooden board against a fair computer; tap to aim, tap again to place, no pinch needed.

Strategy.name: Railknot: Subway Map Puzzle
Strategy.pitch: Draw subway lines between stations as the city grows and keep the platforms from overcrowding.

Strategy.name: Wobblewar: Battle Simulator
Strategy.pitch: Place a wobbly cartoon army within budget, press fight and watch the physics battle.

Racing.name: Doodle Legs
Racing.pitch: Sketch any curve to shape your cube's spinning legs, then redraw mid-race so big arcs vault steps and small ones slip under low roofs.

Racing.name: Tiptoe Tower
Racing.pitch: Steer a runner down rooftop lanes, stacking heels while dodging brick walls, splitting across rails, then climbing a rainbow multiplier podium.

Racing.name: Flip Volt
Racing.pitch: Throttle a glowing neon bike along a curving light track, backflipping in midair and landing on both wheels to reach each level's finish gate.

Racing.name: Porch Toss: Newspaper Bike Ride
Racing.pitch: Pedal down a suburban street and release at the right moment to toss newspapers into mailboxes, braking for crossing cars and chasing perfect-throw combos.

Racing.name: Tube Rush
Racing.pitch: Steer an inflatable tube down twisting water slides against rival animals, bumping opponents and flying off curves to cut corners and climb the placings.

Racing.name: Splitstream
Racing.pitch: Drag to stretch or squeeze a roller-skater's legs so each skate stays on its rail, collecting gems along winding sunset tracks.

Word & Math.name: Seekaloo: Word Search Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe across themed letter grids to circle hidden words before moving on to bigger grids.

Word & Math.name: Cipherleaf: Quote Code Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Crack the number code to reveal a famous quote or proverb, one letter at a time.

Word & Math.name: Letterloom: Anagram Crossword Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe around a letter wheel to spell words and fill a crossword grid, with daily puzzles, hints, bonus words and scenic levels.

Word & Math.name: Ninefold: Daily Sudoku Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: A clean, classic sudoku with four difficulty tiers, pencil notes, hints and undo, plus a daily puzzle everyone shares and a mistake limit.

Word & Math.name: Think Twice!
Word & Math.pitch: Short trick puzzles on a notebook page, like popping balloons or flipping a frown, reward lateral thinking, with free hints and three tries per level.

Word & Math.name: Sumweave: Math Grid Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Fill the blanks in a grid of crossing equations from a tray of numbers, with a fresh daily puzzle.

Idle.name: Bonk Box
Idle.pitch: Fling, firework and flatten a ragdoll stickman, earn coins, unlock toys and hats, and keep a daily streak going.

Idle.name: Viral Den
Idle.pitch: Tap to film clips and watch followers climb while cash buys camera, lights, room and gear upgrades that visibly transform your streamer room across levels.

Idle.name: Liftoff Lab: Space Program for Your AI Agents
Idle.pitch: Coding agents' activity builds and fuels rockets at launch pads, then you steer each launch through rings to reach progressively farther planets.

Idle.name: Bellhop Boss
Idle.pitch: Drag your bellhop around a pastel hotel, checking in guests and collecting cash to buy new rooms and staff, unlocking themed floors.

Idle.name: Cookie Baker Clicker
Idle.pitch: Click the cookie and buy buildings and upgrades to bake more.

Idle.name: Idle Soccer
Idle.pitch: Manage a soccer team in an idle-style management game.

3D.name: Forager
3D.pitch: Fly as a honeybee through a procedural 3D meadow, decode the waggle dance, dodge predators, and see in ultraviolet.

3D.name: Operation Ironhold
3D.pitch: Clear a container yard of ten hostiles in three minutes using four weapons, ADS, double jumps and a sniper scope.

3D.name: JS13kGame2026
3D.pitch: Push deeper into the void, defend colored beacons through waves, pick upgrade cards, and take down bosses in desktop, mobile, or VR.

3D.name: Splat Tanks
3D.pitch: Drive toy tanks with up to 8 friends, splatting paint across the floor and growing bigger as you go.

3D.name: Cleanup Protocol
3D.pitch: Blast rogue household robots with an EMP water gun, grab breaker keys, and shut down the murderous SmartHub.

3D.name: Iridium Reach
3D.pitch: Pilot a starship cockpit with a radar display and HUD readouts, hunting enemies through asteroid fields and around space stations beneath a nebula sky.

Sports.name: Pin Pals: Bowling League for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Bowl lane 1 with flick-aimed hook shots while your AI coding agents roll their own lanes, with task results deciding strikes, splits and turkey bonuses.

Sports.name: Plunge Peak: Cliff Diving
Sports.pitch: Leap off the cliff, hold to flip, let go to straighten up and rip a clean head-first entry.

Sports.name: Noggin Cup: 1v1 Soccer
Sports.pitch: Drag to run, tap to jump-kick and outscore a big-noggin rival in a 60-second 1v1 soccer match.

Sports.name: Hoopwing: Winged Basketball Hoops
Sports.pitch: Tap to flutter a winged basketball and drop it down through every hoop; clean swishes stack a fiery combo.

Sports.name: Swish Street: Basketball Shooting
Sports.pitch: Hold to charge a vertical meter, release in the green to swish hoops, with streaks, shifting city courts and level progression.

Sports.name: Backyard Plop: Bean Bag Toss
Sports.pitch: Drag up to flick bean bags at a cornhole board, scoring 3 for the hole and 1 for the board while rival bags knock yours aside.

Cards.name: Silkline: Spider Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Classic spider solitaire with 1, 2 or 4 suits: build King-to-Ace runs, deal new rows, unlimited undo.

Cards.name: Fourbay: Four Cell Solitaire
Cards.pitch: The classic four-cell patience: park cards in four free cells, build down in alternating colours and send every suit home.

Cards.name: Sandstep: Pyramid Solitaire
Cards.pitch: Classic pyramid solitaire: pair cards that add up to 13 to clear the pyramid, with three passes through the stock.

Cards.name: Heartwick: Hearts Card Game
Cards.pitch: Play Hearts against three fair computer players: pass three cards, dodge the queen of spades or shoot the moon.

Cards.name: Trumpline: Spades Card Game
Cards.pitch: Play Spades with a computer partner: bid or go nil, trump with spades, dodge bags and race to 200 or 300.

Cards.name: Cardcairn: Deckbuilder Roguelike
Cards.pitch: Climb a three-act mountain with a badger and a deck you build card by card: fight cartoon monsters, collect relics and beat three bosses.

Kids.name: Blubbo: Virtual Pet Care
Kids.pitch: Feed, wash, tuck in and dress up a squishy jelly pet, and play three mini-games together for coins.

Kids.name: Peekaboo Pals: Animal Memory Match
Kids.pitch: Peek at the animal cards, then flip them to find matching pairs on a table that grows each level, with hearts for mistakes.

Kids.name: Boop Board: Bubble Popper Fidget Game
Kids.pitch: Press or swipe across bubbles on squishy rainbow critter boards to pop them all before the sun-clock runs out, with some bubbles puffing back up.

Kids.name: Sudsy Lane: Kids Car Wash Game
Kids.pitch: Rub muddy toy trucks clean with a sponge, rinse and dry them, then add stickers, with a new vehicle each level.

Kids.name: Tinty: Pixel Color by Number
Kids.pitch: Pick a colour and drag to fill the numbered pixels of 57 cute pictures.

Kids.name: Rungrush: Ladders and Slides Board Game
Kids.pitch: Roll the die, climb the ladders and whoosh down the slides in a race to square 100 against the computer.

Makeover.name: Tip Top: Nail Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Fill each client's order by choosing a nail shape, filing, polishing and stamping art, then see the whole hand finished in that look.

Makeover.name: Spin Bakes: Cake Decorating Game
Makeover.pitch: Hold to pipe textured icing rings onto a spinning cake, switch colours per layer, smooth it, and shake on toppings to match each customer's order.

Makeover.name: Snip Studio: Hair Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Wash, cut, dye and style a client's hair to match a reference look, with funny client requests driving each short level.

Makeover.name: Goo Lab: Slime Simulator ASMR
Makeover.pitch: Drip dyes into glue, stir to match the recipe card, then squish and poke the soft slime, with add-ins and scoring across stages.

Makeover.name: Glowfit Runway: Dress Up Fashion Battle
Makeover.pitch: Dress your chibi model for a themed brief, match the palette, strut the pastel runway and win the simulated fan vote against three rivals.

Retro.name: SkiFree.js
Retro.pitch: Weave a skier downhill past trees and jumps while a yeti hunts you, in a simple endless chase that rewards quick reflexes.

Retro.name: Tank War
Retro.pitch: Defend your base and destroy enemy tanks in a top-down arcade battle.

Retro.name: Asteroids
Retro.pitch: Rotate and thrust a small triangular ship through drifting vector rocks, shooting them apart while dodging fragments in a faithful, stripped-down arcade loop.
